# sigstore-cosign-mcp
# Sigstore cosign + rekor transparency log verification for signed container images + git tags + binaries.

## Install
```bash
pip install sigstore-cosign-mcp
```

## Auth & Rate Limits
- Free tier: 10 calls/day. No API key required.
- Pro tier (£79/mo): unlimited + signed attestations.
- Enterprise (£1,499/mo): white-label + on-premise.

## Tools (5)

### `verify_image_signature(query, api_key)`
Verify cosign signature on container image

### `query_rekor_log(query, api_key)`
Query Rekor transparency log entries

### `verify_attestation(query, api_key)`
Verify in-toto attestation on artifact

### `check_keyless_identity(query, api_key)`
Verify keyless (OIDC) signing identity

### `list_trusted_certs(query, api_key)`
List Fulcio trusted root certificates

## Pairs with
- `meok-attestation-api` — HMAC signing for compliance certs
- `meok-attestation-verify` — public verification
